name: For Great Honor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Many brave fighters look up to you, adventurer. You continue to be an example for all in the fight against the Alliance. What news do you bring from your journeys?
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: You continue to honor the Horde, adventurer. I'm glad to see you haven't turned soft.
narrative.requestItemsText: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 14,900 XP in all.
